source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Enable Persistence-Mode via cmd: nvidia-smi -pm 1
2. Run Software-Test via cmd: dcgmi diag -v -r software
3. Disable Persistence-Mode via cmd: nvidia-smi -pm 0

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: 1. The result of Software-Test should be PASS without errors.

original_test_intent: Run the approved DCGM software diagnostic on the full target GPU set, obtain the complete tool result without errors, correlate unexpected system logs, and preserve/restore persistence state.
original_method: Validate compatible DCGM and exact deployed syntax, capture GPU/workload/MIG/persistence/log baseline, execute source persistence enable plus verbose software diagnostic under one approved plan, then disable or restore persistence and compare post-logs.
manual_activity: One authorized user approves the fixed diagnostic/state-restoration plan. Package validation, persistence commands, diagnostic and evidence collection are machine-executable; no physical/manual core is present.
required_inputs: Approved DCGM/dcgmi and matching driver versions
GPU UUID/DCGM-ID/slot target set and software-test coverage
Deployed help confirming `-v -r software` or an explicitly equivalent syntax
Baseline/final persistence state, OOB/recovery and plan approval
safety_requirements: Resolve command syntax from the installed approved DCGM; do not guess between source and DeepSeek forms.
Verify stable targets and workload/MIG safety before persistence change or diagnostic.
One approval covers the unchanged plan; stop on syntax mismatch, plan deviation, partial state or device/driver error.
Capture full stdout/stderr/return codes and original post-test logs; no automatic retry/reset/reload/workload termination.
Restore only the approved final persistence state.
agent_execution_scope: Collect tool/GPU/workload/MIG/persistence/log baseline and validate exact syntax/plan gates.
Execute the source-aligned persistence enable and complete verbose software diagnostic.
Restore approved final persistence, collect post GPU/driver/BMC/OS health and compare logs.
Report DCGM Tool Result without testcase verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve tools/syntax, target set, workload window, state changes and recovery.
Resolve any unsupported or version-changed diagnostic scope.
Review tool and log evidence and issue PASS/FAIL.
